newsitem.title: USA: Municipal bond sales total $1.3 bln for Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Municipal bond sales total $1.3 bln for Wednesday.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for Wednesday are expected to total $1.3 billion in 33 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $940 million in 19 sales, with a $271 million California Public Works deal topping the list from Bear Stearns & Co.
On the competitive side, 14 sales totaling $338 million are on the schedule. Florida Board of Education's $189.8 million general obligation deal, set for 1100 EST, is the largest.
An additional five sales totaling $90 million are on the possible calendar, meaning underwriters have said they may price the bonds Wednesday depending on market conditions.
